Title: Vihaan and the Family

Cast

1. Vihaan - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Zoya - 13 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Anita - 41 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Ananya - 10 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Anita and Ananya stand near him.]

Anita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Vihaan peeks out from behind the door.]

Vihaan (gently): "And then?"

[Vihaan bursts out laughing.]

Vihaan: "Ananya, listen!"

[Vihaan smiles at Mother.]

Anita: "What next?"

[Vihaan gets frightened and steps back.]

Vihaan: "Exactly right."

[Lightning flashes across the sky.]

Ananya: "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Zoya: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Vihaan (happily): "And then?"

[Zoya applies kajal to her eyes.]

Zoya (laughing): "Really?"

[Zoya puts on red lipstick.]

Zoya (surprised): "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 3: The road - Day

Vihaan: "Ananya, look over here."

[Vihaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Ananya (happily): "That's great!"

[Vihaan gets into the car.]

Anita: "Vihaan, listen!"

[Vihaan gets on the bus.]

Vihaan: "Mom, look at this."

[Vihaan gets off the school bus.]

Vihaan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Vihaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Vihaan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
